main.title: Shop settings
main.description: One-time and occasional shop configuration lives here, including the Stripe account that receives invoices and payments.

notice.packingSaved: Packing checklist saved for every trip.
notice.packingInvalid: Add between one and twelve packing items.
notice.dockSaved: Dock call time saved for every confirmation and reminder.
notice.dockInvalid: Enter a dock call time between 5 and 180 minutes.
notice.unitsSaved: Units saved. Recorded depths, temperatures, and prices keep their numbers — only how they are read changes.
notice.unitsInvalid: Choose a depth unit, a water temperature unit, and a currency from the lists.
notice.rentalPricesInvalid: Enter each price as a dollar amount (or leave it blank), between $0 and $100,000.
notice.contactInvalid: Use a complete email address, or empty the box to take it off your public pages.
notice.addressInvalid: Use a two-letter country code, or empty the box to leave it unset.
notice.reviewUrlInvalid: Enter a full https:// link, or empty the box to stop asking for reviews.
notice.connectFailed: The Stripe connection didn't complete. Try connecting again.
notice.notConfigured: Online payments aren't switched on for this DiveDay setup yet. Whoever runs your DiveDay hosting needs to finish the Stripe configuration first.
notice.notAuthorized: The rental catalog, rental prices, and Stripe connection are payment settings, limited to owners and managers.
notice.timezoneInvalid: That isn’t a timezone we recognize — pick one from the list.

timezone.heading: Timezone
timezone.description: The zone every date and time in DiveDay is read and written in.
timezone.detail: The board, the manifest, and the times divers see on your booking pages all follow it. Changing it re-reads your existing departures at their new local times; it does not move them.
timezone.label: Timezone

contact.heading: Public contact details
contact.description: The front-desk email and phone printed on your course pages.
contact.detail: A diver who cannot find a date gets a ready-written email to send you. Use an address the whole team reads, not a personal one. Empty the email box to take the form down.

address.heading: Shop address
address.description: Where a diver meets the boat or walks into the storefront.
address.detail: Your shop's physical business address, not a staff member's personal one. Published so search engines can place your shop as a real venue. Every field is optional, and empties independently.
address.noMatches: No matches — fill the boxes in below instead.
address.lookupFailed: Address lookup isn't available right now. Fill the boxes in below.
address.lookupResting: That's a lot of lookups for one hour — searching pauses for a bit. Fill the boxes in below, or try again later.

reviewLink.heading: Review link
reviewLink.description: Your Google Business, TripAdvisor, or Facebook review page.
reviewLink.detail: When set, a diver's post-trip recap invites them to leave a review — empty the box to stop asking.
reviewLink.label: Review link

packing.heading: Trip packing checklist
packing.description: One item per line. Divers see this same concise list on every trip.
packing.label: Checklist items

dockCall.heading: Dock call time
dockCall.description: How early divers are asked to arrive before departure.
dockCall.detail: Time for gear setup, cert checks, and the briefing. It appears on booking confirmations, the dock-day rhythm, and every pre-trip reminder.
dockCall.label: Minutes before departure

units.heading: Units
units.description: How your crew reads depths, water temperature, and prices.
units.depthDetail: Depths are always stored in metres, so switching this changes only what you type in and read back — no recorded site depth moves.
units.temperatureDetail: Set separately from the depth unit — plenty of shops publish feet and Celsius. Temperatures are always stored in Celsius, so switching this changes only what you type in and read back.
units.currencyDetail: Changing it does not convert anything: a 130 trip stays 130, it just means 130 of the new currency. Orders and payments already settled keep the currency they were charged in.
units.currencyMismatch: You charge in {shopCurrency}, but Stripe settles this connected account in {accountCurrency}. Stripe will refuse a payment in a currency this account can't settle — either pick {accountCurrency} here, or connect an account that settles in {shopCurrency}.

paymentsGate.notice: The rental catalog, rental prices, and Stripe connection are payment settings, limited to owners and managers. The contact, packing, and dock-call settings above are open to all staff.

rentals.heading: What we rent
rentals.description: The gear and services divers can ask for in their rental fit.
rentals.detail: Untick anything you don't offer — a shop that doesn't stock GoPros never offers one, and it drops off the kit form and the prep list. Most shops don't fill nitrox, so it starts unticked.

rentalPricing.heading: Rental prices
rentalPricing.description: What a diver is quoted for their rental fit.
rentalPricing.detail: Price the full set (usually cheaper) and each piece separately — five items quotes the set, fewer pays per piece. Leave a box blank to settle at the shop.
rentalPricing.fullSetHint: (BCD, reg, wetsuit, mask & fins, weights, dive computer)

stripe.notConnectedDescription: Connect a Stripe account you own.
stripe.notConnectedDetail: DiveDay never holds your money — payments for orders go straight into your own Stripe balance.
stripe.notConfiguredWarning: Online payments aren't configured for this DiveDay instance yet — contact {email} to get it set up.

embed.heading: Website embed
embed.description: Copy-paste snippets that put your live booking calendar on your own website.

calendar.heading: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your departures on the calendar app you already use — read-only, so DiveDay never touches it.

data.heading: Data
data.description: Bring contacts in from a CSV, or take everything back out as a ZIP of CSVs.
data.detail: Neither one touches the settings above.

trial.heading: Your trial
trial.activeDescription: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left, through {endDate}.
trial.expiredDescription: Your trial ended {endDate}. Everything you've set up keeps working.
trial.upgradeBody: Ready to move to a paid plan? Email us and we'll get you set up.

support.description: A bad morning at the counter, a feature you're missing, a bug — write in any time.

whatsapp.heading: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: Send trip reminders and recaps from your shop's own WhatsApp number instead of a platform SMS number.

backup.heading: Backups
backup.description: A weekly copy of everything your shop holds, delivered to storage you own.

team.heading: Team
team.description: Who works here, what each person is allowed to reach, and where your invitations stand.

promos.heading: Promo codes
promos.description: Shop-wide discount codes a diver types at checkout, each with its own dates and limits.

mediaDeletions.heading: {count, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} removed but not yet deleted from storage
mediaDeletions.detail: The photo is already gone from the app; the stored file wasn't — retry the delete, or leave it for tonight's automatic retry.

processorErasures.heading: {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}} from an erased diver still at Stripe
processorErasures.detail: Erasing a diver here also deletes their Stripe customer. These didn't finish. A customer record can be retried — tonight's run will try again on its own. An invoice can't: Stripe copies the name and email onto every invoice when it's issued, and only a data-deletion request to Stripe clears that. File one, then mark it done.

team.title: Team
team.description: Invite staff, set what each person can do, and manage who still has access.

notice.disabled: Account disabled — they can no longer sign in.
notice.removed: Archived — they keep their record and history, and can no longer sign in.
notice.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore that person's access — check their account first.
notice.inviteInvalid: Enter a name, a valid email, and check at least one role.
notice.rolesInvalid: Check at least one role before saving.
notice.inviteAlreadyOnTeam: That person already has an account here.
notice.inviteEmailTaken: That email is already registered to a different shop.
notice.inviteEmailReserved: That email address is reserved and can't receive mail. Invite this teammate at an address they can read.
notice.lastOwner: Can't do that — the shop needs at least one owner. Make someone else an owner first.
notice.notFound: That person isn't on this shop's team.
notice.notAuthorized: Team management is limited to owners and managers.

invite.heading: Invite someone
invite.description: They'll get an email to set their own password. If they're already a diver at your shop, inviting them by the same email adds staff access to their existing record instead of creating a second one.

current.heading: Current team
current.description: Enable, disable, and archive take effect immediately. Role changes below wait for Save changes.

staffRow.archivedToast: Archived {name}. Their record and history stay.

export.title: Data export
export.description: Download everything this shop keeps in DiveDay as plain CSV files — divers, cards, trips, bookings, signed waivers, rental sizes, orders, wait lists, dive sites, and courses. Yours to keep, whenever you want it — including a ready-to-import contacts file another system's import wizard can map directly.

downloadButton.acknowledged: On its way — check your downloads

bundle.heading: What's in the bundle
bundle.description: One ZIP with a README and a CSV for each kind of record. Every date and time carries its timezone, money is in cents, and your archived history comes along too — nothing is lost if you ever move on.

notIncluded.label: Not included, on purpose:
notIncluded.text: offline manifest copies, notification retry queues, Stripe account linkage, the day close-out and buddy-team trails, weather-cancellation cascade state, DiveDay's own reconciliation ledgers, and unstored pasted image URLs. Staff notes, the activity trail, notification outcomes, checkout attempts, promo redemptions and course leads <mono>do</mono> export — they're your records. DiveDay's own photos export as real files in <mono>photos/</mono>. Sign-in credentials, calendar-subscription links, and your connected WhatsApp account never export — see the README.

import.title: Import contacts
import.description: Bring your divers, cards, rental sizes, and prior waiver acceptance in from a CSV — from your old system or from DiveDay's own export. See exactly what comes across below.
import.comingFrom: Coming from <eve>EVE</eve>, <diveshop360>DiveShop360</diveshop360>, or <spreadsheet>a spreadsheet</spreadsheet>? See the matching guide, then come back here to bring it in.

notice.notAuthorized: Importing writes divers' personal and medical records, so it's limited to owners and managers.

contact.detail: Imported as given. A row with an email matches an existing diver on re-import; without one, it's always a new record.

emergencyContact.detail: Name and phone carry over when present.

diveInsurance.detail: Carried across as free text, exactly as your file holds it. Never a gate — just detail the crew wants on hand.

rentalSizes.detail: BCD, wetsuit, boot, and fin sizes become a rental-fit profile.

certificationCard.detail: Imported verified and flagged imported, refresher date included — staff give it a one-tap confirm; unrecognized levels need manual entry.

specialtyCards.detail: Imported as verified specialty cards, flagged imported; each one still needs a staff confirm before the dive that requires it.

nitrox.detail: Imported as a verified nitrox card, flagged imported — but a diver gets plain air until staff confirm it; boarding never waits.

signedWaivers.detail: A row marked already-accepted is trusted, medical clearance included, and marked imported — individual medical answers are never reconstructed, only the outcome.

waiverDocuments.detail: Fetched once from your file's URL and re-stored in DiveDay's own storage for audit. Images and PDFs up to 5 MB.

role.detail: Everyone imports as a diver. Staff roles and logins are never granted by import.

cardOnFile.detail: Stays with your payment processor — DiveDay never imports card or payment data.

pastVisits.detail: One row per booking becomes visit history — not a dive, and it never appears on your schedule or counts toward capacity.

receiptsService.detail: Payment records stay with your processor; gear-service history has nowhere to land — DiveDay tracks sizes, not individual rigs.

wizard.heading: Upload a contacts file
wizard.intro: A CSV from your old system, or DiveDay's own <mono>contacts.csv</mono> export. An email match updates that diver on re-import; without one, it's a new record. Nothing is written until you review the preview and confirm.
wizard.ignoredMedicalColumns: Left behind on purpose: {columns}. These weren't recognized as a waiver column, so their contents never import. A recognized “waiver accepted” column is trusted instead; see below.
wizard.waiverRowsNotice: {count, plural, one {# row claims} other {# rows claim}} a waiver already accepted at a prior shop. DiveDay trusts that — including its medical clearance — and marks the record “imported” so it's never confused with a release signed here. See “What comes across” above.
wizard.visitRowsNotice: {count, plural, one {# row records} other {# rows record}} a past visit. See “What comes across” above for what that does and doesn't mean.
wizard.previewSwipeHint: Swipe the table to see every column →
wizard.hiddenRowsNotice: Showing the first {limit} rows. All {total} are imported on confirm.

result.cardsLine: {cardsAdded, plural, one {# card} other {# cards}}, {specialtyAdded, plural, one {# specialty card} other {# specialty cards}}, and {nitroxAdded, plural, one {# nitrox card} other {# nitrox cards}} imported and flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm on each diver's record.
result.rowsMergedNote: {count} row(s) added cards to a diver an earlier row brought in.
result.cardsSkippedNote: {count} card(s) already on those divers' records were left untouched.
result.cardsHeldByAnother: {count} card number(s) in the file are already on a different diver in your shop, so those cards were not added to anyone. Check the file for a repeated number, then enter those cards by hand.
result.specialtyGateNote: A dive that requires one of those specialties waits on that confirm — tap it on the diver's record and the gate opens.
result.waiversLine: {count, plural, one {# waiver} other {# waivers}} imported as accepted, marked “imported” on the diver's profile.
result.waiversSkippedExistingNote: {count} diver(s) already had a current waiver on file, left untouched.
result.waiversSkippedNoTemplateNote: {count} skipped — set up a waiver template first.
result.waiverDocumentsFailedNote: {count} document link(s) didn't fetch and were left off the record.
result.visitsLine: {count, plural, one {# past visit} other {# past visits}} added to divers' shop history.
result.visitsSkippedNote: {count} were already imported and were left as they are — re-running the same export doesn't double anyone's history.

issues.emailInvalid: Email "{email}" doesn't look valid — imported without an email.
issues.expiryUnreadable: Refresher-due date "{value}" can't be read as a date — the card imports for staff review instead of as verified, so nobody boards on a date we guessed.
issues.expiryAssumedMonthFirst: Refresher-due date "{value}" read as {parsed} (month first). Check it if your file writes day first.
issues.cardMarkedUnverified: Your file marks this card "{status}" — imported for staff review rather than as verified, since your own records don't call it checked.
issues.specialtyNotGated: Specialty "{specialty}" isn't a specialty we gate on (deep, wreck, night, drysuit) — nothing imported for it.
issues.specialtyNoCardNumber: Specialty "{specialty}" has no card number on the row — not imported. A card without a number can't be verified.
issues.specialtyImportedVerified: {count, plural, one {Specialty card} other {# specialty cards}} imported as verified from your records — flagged imported. A dive that requires one waits until a staffer confirms they've seen the card.
issues.specialtyImportedPending: {count, plural, one {Specialty card} other {# specialty cards}} imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.levelNamesSpecialty: Certification "{level}" names a specialty, not a level, and this row's specialty column was used instead — no level card imported. Add that card by hand if it's a separate one.
issues.levelIsTechnical: Certification "{level}" is a technical or overhead-environment rating, not a rung on the recreational ladder — not imported, and never read as a nearby level. DiveDay doesn't gate on these; record it by hand if your shop does.
issues.levelNotGated: Certification "{level}" isn't a level we gate on — card not imported. Add it by hand if it's a real card.
issues.levelNoCardNumber: Certification level "{level}" has no usable card number — card not imported. A card without a number can't be verified.
issues.certImportedVerified: Card imported as verified from your records — flagged imported, with a one-tap confirm for staff.
issues.certImportedPending: Card imported for staff review — see the note above.
issues.nitroxImported: Nitrox card imported as verified from your records — flagged imported. Fills give plain air until a staffer taps confirm.
issues.nitroxNoCardNumber: Nitrox marked on the source with no card number — add and verify a nitrox card in DiveDay.
issues.waiverDateInvalid: Waiver accepted date "{value}" isn't a real calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD) — imported dated to today instead.
issues.waiverImported: Waiver imported as accepted — trusted from the prior shop, including medical clearance, and marked “imported” so it's never confused with a release signed in DiveDay.
issues.dobInvalid: Date of birth "{value}" isn't a plausible calendar date (expected YYYY-MM-DD, 1900 or later, not in the future) — imported without it.
issues.visitDateUnreadable: Visit date "{value}" isn't a date we can read — the diver imports without this visit.
issues.visitNoReference: Visit imported without a booking reference — a re-import matches it on date, name, and amount, so two identical bookings on one day come in as one visit.
issues.visitNoDate: This row names a past booking but carries no date — the diver imports without this visit.
issues.mergedDuplicate: Same diver as row {row} ({email}) — this row's cards, waiver, and past visit are added to them, contact details left as the earlier row has them.
issues.noEmailNewRecord: No email — imported as a new record; a re-import can't match it to update.

errors.notOwnerOrManager: Importing contacts is limited to the shop's owner or manager.
errors.csvRequired: Choose a CSV file to import.
errors.noImportableRows: No importable rows — every row was missing a name or duplicated.
errors.fileTooLarge: The file is too large — the limit is {limitMb} MB.
errors.tooManyColumns: Too many columns ({count}) — the limit is {limit}.
errors.tooManyRows: Too many rows ({count}) — the limit is {limit} per import. Split the file and import it in batches.
errors.cellTooLongHeader: A cell in the header row is longer than {limit} characters — check for a pasted document instead of a spreadsheet.
errors.cellTooLongRow: A cell in row {row} is longer than {limit} characters — check for a pasted document instead of a spreadsheet.
errors.noNameColumn: No name column found. The file needs a full name, or first and last name, to import people.

embed.title: Website embed
embed.description: Paste one of these into your own website so divers can browse and book without leaving your site. Both point at the same live schedule — no separate setup, no sync to keep working.
embed.notConfigured: Embed links need a configured public hosting address for this DiveDay instance — contact {email} to get it set up.

calendarEmbed.heading: Calendar embed
calendarEmbed.description: A full booking calendar, sized to fit wherever you place it on your page. Best for a dedicated "Book now" page on your site.
calendarEmbed.attributionNote: Includes a small "Powered by DiveDay" credit link under the calendar, on your own page — not inside the widget.

bookButton.heading: "Book a dive" button
bookButton.description: A plain link styled as a button, no iframe. Opens your DiveDay schedule in a new tab — the simplest option, and the one to use if you take online payment, since a checkout page may refuse to open inside another site's frame.

embed.footer: Both snippets point at <link>your public schedule</link>. Editing a trip, adding a departure, or changing your rental prices shows up the moment a diver loads the embed — nothing to republish.
